message.content:
This screen is a **manga details page** (likely from a manga reader app, e.g., MangaDex or a similar platform) displaying information about the manga *Raijin's Fury*.  

### UI Breakdown:  
- **Top Bar**: Contains navigation (back arrow), version selector (`v2`), file/folder icons, refresh, and a “Set to Private” button.  
- **Manga Cover & Title**: A cover image of *Raijin's Fury* (with a stormy, lightning-themed design) is centered, with the title below it.  
- **Metadata**: Shows the source (*MangaDex*), status (*Ongoing*), reading progress (75%, Chapter 36 of 48), and key stats (48 Chapters, 245 MB size, English Language).  
- **Description Section**: A truncated synopsis of the manga’s plot (“A legendary swordsman wielding the power of thunder seeks vengeance…”) with a “Read more” option to expand.  
- **Action Button**: A prominent orange “Continue” button (with a play icon) to resume reading.  
- **Additional Icons**: Share, download, and menu (three dots) buttons at the top right of the cover.  


The UI is dark-themed, focusing on presenting manga details, progress, and a clear call-to-action to continue reading.
